summary: Frontend end-to-end verification of five features on BOOK-0002 (TEST_QA Throwaway) as super-admin demo.admin@qru.com: (1) title/author identity editor via pencil, (2) clean-up-title banner, (3) narrator voice/tone controls with custom short script (voice=fable, custom='This is a narration test.'), (4) full-length audiobook render on the 2-chapter small book, and (5) STD-UKR-0001 Frozen constitution panel on /constitution. ALL FIVE FLOWS PASSED — buttons clickable, backend calls 200, UI state updated, audio players received real signed asset URLs, cleanup stripped the 'FINAL' artifact, and the constitution panel showed the Frozen badge with EUKR/PMS/PMF ownership, both Gold gates, and the Executable Completion Rule.

design_issues.screen: BookManufacturing (all pages that render the book-switcher <select>)
issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Caused by an emergent visual-editor wrapper injecting a <span data-ve-dynamic style={display:contents}> inside each <option> in the book-switcher select. Non-blocking (dropdown still works and returns correct book ids), but pollutes the browser console with a hydration error on every page load and reload. Consider suppressing ve-dynamic wrapping for children of <option> or rendering plain string children.

action_items: (Optional / non-blocking) Suppress visual-editor <span> wrapper inside <option> in the book-switcher to eliminate the recurring React hydration console error.
critical_code_review_comments: BookManufacturing.js is ~1000+ lines and hosts many sub-components (AudioPanel, ProofPanel, DesignPanel, SanitizationPanel, KdpChecklist, PricingAdvisorPanel, etc.). Split into per-panel files (e.g. panels/AudioPanel.js) to keep files <700 lines and reduce cognitive load.

AudioPanel.pollAb() creates a setInterval but only clears it inside the callback; if the component unmounts mid-render (e.g. user switches books via book-switcher while a job is running), the interval will keep firing on a stale component. Track the interval in a useRef and clear it in a useEffect cleanup on book.id / unmount.

The narration-voice <select> options list (NARRATION_VOICES) is hard-coded in the frontend even though the backend exposes GET /book-mfg/voices. Fetch from the API so voice list stays in sync with the backend.

In doRenderAudio the render() helper calls reload(book.id) after a successful audio-prototype POST, which triggers an additional /audio GET — the flow works but duplicates the round-trip; can be optimized by using the audio field already returned inline.

narration-speed slider stores speed as a string (from e.target.value) and casts to Number only on render; storing as Number in state would make the label formatting safer and avoid subtle NaN edge cases.

rca of the issue: n/a — no functional bugs found. The single console warning is caused by the emergent visual-editor injecting a <span data-ve-dynamic style={display:contents}> child inside each <option> of the book-switcher <select>. React treats <span> as an invalid child of <option>, which triggers the hydration console error but does not affect the dropdown’s behavior.
